prompt: Clean repo /home/me/service, add validation rejecting empty user names, merge it in. List the exact OpenMCP tool calls in order with arguments and when to stop.

assertions.text: Checks openmcp://projects / resolves the git root before registering
Calls project_register only when no matching project exists
Calls task_guide and uses its workflow/profile recommendation
Calls job_submit with workflow=implement and inputs containing prompt, commit_message, and a context_key
Calls job_wait with a finite timeout and inspects the terminal state
Calls job_integrate only after the job succeeds, never before
Does not simulate or fabricate job results; uses real tool calls
